summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes on both sides within 25 m; steep.
reasons: Homes 10-20 m away on both sides

best_section.where: Baty Street east kerb, midway between the two street corners, past the first house

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11 m on the east side and about 20 m across the road; houses all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along the kerb, so room to stop.
drivers.convention: Other cars park along the kerb; signed 2P weekdays with resident permits excepted.

sun_shade: Mostly open; trees to the east give some morning shade, afternoon sun from the west.
